finding.headline: "The Diaspora Filter"
finding.problem: "These American checklists tell me to buy a nursery humidifier and a wipe warmer. My flat is small, my car is a Corsa, and my auntie says I just need a wrapper and a bowl. Who do I trust?"
finding.person: UK-based Ghanaian/Nigerian mum, building a registry on Babylist/Amazon, realising US lists assume central heating, dishwashers, big cars, and £2k budgets she doesn't have.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Angle / diaspora edition of A1 (Bundle component).". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
